name: Change%
description: This keyword gives you the difference between the Last Traded Price of an instrument and the previous day's close price of that instrument in percentage.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword gives you the difference between the Last Traded Price of an instrument and the previous day's close price of that instrument in percentage.

![Example](./images/img-1631706643.png)

Here, 2 implies 2%, -2 implies -2% and so on

Note- No need to add % sign at end of the number
